description: API handlers must not access the database directly. All persistence goes through the repository layer so queries stay testable and access rules live in one place.
All exported functions in src/payments require an explicit return type annotation. Money-handling code must never rely on inferred types.
Never log credentials, API keys, session tokens, or other secrets at any log level. Redact sensitive fields before passing objects to the logger.
Prefer the async fs/promises APIs over synchronous fs calls in request-handling code paths to avoid blocking the event loop.
